$comment: Dependency lock manifest for Batch PDF Publisher. This is the human-editable source of truth for runtime dependencies. Build-SBOM.ps1 reads this file, verifies each path resolves, and computes SHA-256 hashes from the actual files. Do not edit sbom.cdx.json by hand — regenerate it via Build-SBOM.ps1.

dependencies.name: MSForms
dependencies.source: Microsoft Office (VFS path varies by Office bitness and version)

knownUnknowns.description: Inventor API transitive COM components are not enumerated. The RxInventor.tlb type library is a facade over a large set of Autodesk COM servers whose specific versions are determined at runtime by the Inventor installation.
PDF Translator AddIn GUID is not resolved at build time. The AddIn is discovered at runtime via ApplicationAddIns.ItemById(PDF_GUID) with enumeration fallback (see modPDFFileIO.PDF_FindAddIn).

Windows COM components (Scripting.FileSystemObject, Scripting.Dictionary, System.Collections.ArrayList, ADODB.Stream, Shell.Application, htmlfile, OLE DataObject, WScript.Shell) are provided by the OS. Their versions track Windows Update and are outside SBOM scope.

notes: To add a dependency: add a new entry to the 'dependencies' array with name, version, purl, license, and a non-empty 'paths' array.
Build-SBOM.ps1 will fail if any path in 'paths' is not found on the build machine (unless -AllowMissingHashes is passed).
Hashes are computed at build time from the actual files. Never hand-edit hashes into this file.
Registry of resolved components ends up in sbom.cdx.json. That file is the generated artifact — do not edit it.
